definitions.explanation: A written account of a person's life, typically focusing on their achievements, character, and historical significance.

examples.japanese: {偉人|いじん}の{伝記|でんき}を{読|よ}むのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like reading biographies of great people.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{伝記|でんき}が{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
{伝記|でんき}{映画|えいが}が{賞|しょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The biographical film won an award.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝記|でんき}を{書|か}く (to write a biography)
- {伝記|でんき}を{読|よ}む (to read a biography)
- {伝記|でんき}{小説|しょうせつ} (biographical novel)
- {伝記|でんき}{映画|えいが} (biographical film, biopic)
- {自伝|じでん} (autobiography - written by oneself)

HOMOPHONE NOTE: Be careful not to confuse with:
- {電気|でんき} (electricity)
- {電器|でんき} (electrical appliances)
- {伝奇|でんき} (romance, legend)

RELATED:
- {自伝|じでん} (autobiography)
- {評伝|ひょうでん} (critical biography)
